acceptance: The proposal opens with a status line naming the audited version and the releases that shipped its recommendations.
No 'local checkout' references remain; each cites a tag or commit.
Merged to Theseus main with hosted SHIP.
description:
From the independent review of Theseus #72 (docs/review-comment-format-proposal.md, merged 51501be5, shipped in v0.2.11), two P3 notes were left unfixed so the release would not be delayed:
1. Lines 7-36 (the Summary) use the present tense ('Today', 'currently the machine API in eight places') for problems that #59, #60, #62, #64, #65 and #66 have since fixed. Line 20 ('Line 1 is `### review-verdict: failure…`') and line 27 are no longer true on main. Fix: a one-line status note under the title, for example 'Audit of v0.2.8 (360cead); recommendations 1-6 shipped in v0.2.10 and v0.2.11'.
2. Lines 41 and 242 cite 'an older local checkout' and 'the local v0.2.4 checkout' (docs/hosted-workflows.md:203-207). Replace these with 'at tag v0.2.4' so readers can follow them.
Guardrails: docs only; no change to design content; G7 merge rule (hosted SHIP; independent review optional for docs-only per the rule's scope).
